title: Detector-in-the-Loop Anti-Jamming for UAV Links: code and results
description: Code, Kaggle notebook and results for a detector-in-the-loop evaluation of UAV anti-jamming on real Wi-Fi spectral-scan measurements (WiFiSpectralJam), including the Adaptive Feedback Threshold (AFT) policy and a leakage-aware audit of the public UAV jamming dataset of Li et al. (2022). Raw datasets are not redistributed.
